notes: Reported secondhand in a Beverly Hills staff report (meeting Feb 18, 2020) comparing other agencies' Via programs; not West Sacramento's own primary contract record. Following an RFP, City of West Sacramento selected "NoMad Transit LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Via Transportation, Inc." to operate a pilot microtransit program launched May 2018 (7 Mercedes Metris vans: 6 standard + 1 WAV). Quote: "annual budget for the first year of operations was $749,000, which included $61,000 for performance evaluation study conducted by UC Berkeley" (p.2). "The ODR vehicle fleet are subleased from a third-party vehicle leaser contracted by Via... vehicles are driven by independent contractors registered in the Via system" (p.2) -> Turnkey. One-year pilot ended May 2019, superseded by extension (see companion row from same packet).

Following the one-year pilot (ended May 2019), "the West Sacramento City Council extended its contract with Via to continue operation of the ODR program through June 30, 2020. The contract included an expansion of service hours and increase in the fleet size to eleven Metris vans (nine standard and two wheelchair accessible vehicles)" (p.2). Quote: "The operating budget for the second year increased to $1,905,000 due to expanded operating hours" and "The contract extension through June 2020 is funded with TDA funds" (p.2). Status beyond June 30, 2020 not stated in this packet. Reported secondhand via Beverly Hills Feb 18, 2020 staff report (Attachment 2).
